name: @argszero/dsh-image-route-guard
description: Keep an image block off a dsh route that cannot carry one: the runtime projects images to text only when the MODEL declares itself text-only, never when the ROUTE (provider + protocol) has no legal wire shape for the block, so a vision model on such a protocol sends it anyway and a 400 poisons the session permanently. Mounted on the LLM runtime, this projects image blocks to the harness's own text placeholder for the routes an operator declares image-incapable, leaves every other route untouched, and dispatches an unconfigured or unreadable call with the caller's own options object.
